description: This Python script provides a function to convert a list of Task ORM objects into CSV format bytes. It specifically formats task attributes including ID, project ID, column ID, title, description, priority, due date, creation and update timestamps, and associated tags into CSV rows.

methods.name: bytes tasks_to_csv(tasks: Iterable[Task])
methods.description: Converts an iterable of Task ORM objects into CSV-formatted bytes, including specified task fields and tags.
